name: Append-only dish/menu repository and exact-offer availability streams
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate authorization
boundary: One combined asynchronous repository contract, deterministic canonical serialization and instance-local in-memory reference adapter. This precedes private management services/controllers; do not split persistence slices yet.
authority: Keep FOOD-001 and FOOD-002B/C unchanged. Reuse FOOD-002B validators/revision helpers and FOOD-002C validation results rather than redefining domain semantics.
Authorization remains completely outside this repository. IDs never establish permission.
Stored published state is an immutable domain snapshot only; it does not activate routes, authorize exposure, prove readiness or enable ordering.

types.FoodMenuRepositoryResult<T>: Readonly<{ ok: true; value: T }> | Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: 'invalid-input' | 'storage'; message: string }> }>
types.FoodMenuAppendOutcome<T>: Readonly<{ outcome: 'created' | 'already-present'; snapshot: T }> | Readonly<{ outcome: 'conflict'; reason: 'different-content' }>
types.FoodMenuReadOutcome<T>: Readonly<{ outcome: 'found'; snapshot: T }> | Readonly<{ outcome: 'not-found' }>
types.FoodMenuPage<T, C>: Readonly<{ items: readonly T[]; nextCursor?: C }>

repository.construction: Synchronous and I/O-free; require callable getProduct/getRecipe, rejecting malformed dependencies with a fixed TypeError. No dependency calls during construction; no memory/global fallback dependency.
methods: getAvailability(offerId: FoodServingOfferId, offerVersion: number, revision: number): Promise<FoodMenuRepositoryResult<FoodMenuReadOutcome<FoodServingOfferAvailability>>>

listAvailabilityRevisions(offerId: FoodServingOfferId, offerVersion: number, options?: FoodAvailabilityHistoryOptions): Promise<FoodMenuRepositoryResult<FoodMenuPage<FoodServingOfferAvailability, number>>>
repository.runtimeValidation: Strongly typed signatures do not bypass canonical runtime validation. Reject malformed IDs, unsafe versions/revisions, unknown option/input properties and coercion. No delete/update/overwrite/destructive reset/merge/renumber operation. Dish-filtered offer listing deferred.

dependencyRules: Use injected getProduct/getRecipe for exact historical reads only. No latest methods, writes, mutation or copying private snapshots/evidence into FOOD-002D storage.
Validate resolved snapshots and their exact requested ID/version, not just a found result. Exact product-to-recipe correspondence must pass FOOD-002B/FOOD-001A validation.
Missing required FOOD-001 dependency during append maps to invalid-input. A malformed/corrupt/mismatched dependency response or thrown/rejected dependency access maps to storage.
Missing/corrupt required dependency when reconstructing stored records maps to storage, including append-time reconstruction of an existing predecessor or exact retry record.
No implicit context retargeting; all contexts are transient validation inputs and excluded from stored canonical payloads.
appendAndRetryOrder: First validate caller shape, canonical IDs/versions, exact dependency context and domain record sufficiently to construct canonical serialized content.

Initial methods require version/revision 1 even on retries. Revision methods require canonical positive-safe expected predecessor, no overflow, next exactly predecessor + 1 and an existing valid predecessor; run full domain revision validation before retry comparison.
Offer revision validation includes stable offer-to-dish association; an attempted move to another dish is invalid-input even if its key exists.

Then inspect the exact attempted identity/version/revision key. Reconstruct and verify any existing stored record. Identical canonical content returns successful already-present; different valid canonical content returns successful conflict with only reason different-content.
Historical identical retries remain already-present after newer records exist when predecessor/context is valid. Do not require predecessor to remain current before evaluating an existing key.

Only if key does not exist, enforce current-predecessor sequencing. Initial creation requires an empty identity/availability stream; revision creation requires greatest stored sequential version/revision equal expected predecessor.

Missing/skipped/wrong/noncurrent predecessors, initial not 1 and overflow are invalid-input failures, not conflict outcomes. Conflict is reserved for valid different canonical content at an existing exact key.
On successful new insertion return created. Never overwrite, renumber, merge, retarget evidence/references or retry automatically.

referentialIntegrity.presentation: Exact FOOD-001 product and recipe must exist; validateFoodDishPresentation enforces supplied refs and product-to-recipe correspondence. Revisions validate complete previous and next contexts with reviseFoodDishPresentation.
referentialIntegrity.offer: Exact referenced presentation must already exist in this repository and reconstruct successfully. ValidateFoodServingOffer uses its exact FOOD-001 context; reviseFoodServingOffer enforces same stable dish association. No latest presentation substitution.
referentialIntegrity.publication: Collect all exact presentation and offer references from snapshot; every referenced version must already exist. Build bounded exact context arrays for validateFoodMenuPublication/reviseFoodMenuPublication. De-duplicate context keys only when assembling contexts, never silently de-duplicate domain selections. FOOD-002C enforces compatibility, selections, ordering and uniqueness.
referentialIntegrity.availability: Exact offer ID/version must already exist and reconstruct successfully. ValidateFoodServingOfferAvailability enforces the immutable observation shape. No availability data is required to append an offer or publication.
referentialIntegrity.missingReferences: Absent newly submitted referenced presentation/offer maps to invalid-input. Corrupt/inconsistent already-stored records or missing dependencies of those records map to storage.
referentialIntegrity.historical: Exact historical reads and publication reconstruction resolve recorded old versions only. No deletion; historical references remain resolvable unless records/dependencies are corrupt. Latest methods never participate in exact reconstruction.

availabilityAuthority: Private append-only stream key is exact (offerId, offerVersion); observation revision is a distinct positive safe-integer sequencing dimension.
Initial revision 1; explicit consecutive predecessor/current enforcement and retry precedence apply exactly as for entity histories.
Current means greatest successfully stored sequential revision in that exact stream. No wall-clock/freshness assertion, caller-order selection, latest-offer substitution or mutable pointer.

A new offer version begins with no observation and getCurrentAvailability returns not-found until revision 1 is explicitly appended for that version. Never copy/inherit availability from an old version.
All historical observations, including retired, remain readable. Current streams for different offer versions are independent.
Changing availability never changes offer/publication history and never publishes/unpublishes anything. Preserve all six FOOD-002C states without readiness/order authority.

resultsAndFailures.append: Successful outcomes exactly created | already-present | conflict; conflict is not a repository failure.
resultsAndFailures.read: Successful exact/latest/current read outcomes exactly found | not-found. Missing stream/history produces not-found or successful empty history as appropriate; storage failure never becomes empty success.
resultsAndFailures.invalid-input: Fixed message: Food menu repository input could not be validated.
resultsAndFailures.storage: Fixed message: Food menu repository storage is unavailable.
resultsAndFailures.constructorFailure: TypeError with fixed message: Food menu repository dependencies are unavailable.
resultsAndFailures.sanitization: No source payload excerpts, private evidence, exception strings, stacks or SQL/storage/runtime internals in result text. Catch operational failures into bounded results. Authorization vocabulary is excluded.

serialization.envelope: Fixed field order: formatVersion, recordType, recordId, recordVersion, observationRevision (availability only), snapshot. recordType exactly presentation | offer | publication | availability.
serialization.metadata: recordId is dishId/offerId/publicationId respectively; recordVersion is snapshot.version for the first three families. Availability recordId is snapshot.offer.offerId, recordVersion is snapshot.offer.version, observationRevision is snapshot.revision. Require exact metadata/payload agreement.
serialization.canonicalization: Validate domain first; recursively sort object keys using deterministic UTF-16 code-unit ordering; preserve all array order. Fixed envelope, no trimming/normalization/default inference. Equality depends only on domain snapshots, excluding contextual drafts/dependencies and timestamps.
apis: serializeFoodDishPresentation(input: unknown, product: unknown, recipe: unknown): FoodMenuRepositoryResult<string>
serializeFoodServingOffer(input: unknown, presentation: unknown, product: unknown, recipe: unknown): FoodMenuRepositoryResult<string>
deserializeFoodServingOffer(serialized: unknown, presentation: unknown, product: unknown, recipe: unknown): FoodMenuRepositoryResult<FoodServingOffer>
serializeFoodMenuPublication(input: unknown, presentations: unknown, offers: unknown): FoodMenuRepositoryResult<string>
serialization.synchronous: Serializer/deserializer functions are synchronous and I/O-free with explicitly supplied exact contexts; availability pure codec validates shape, while repository additionally enforces exact-offer existence.
serialization.decode: Reject unsupported format, wrong discriminator, missing/unknown envelope properties, malformed JSON/payload, invalid domain, missing/mismatched exact context, metadata disagreement and canonical reserialization mismatch. Comparing exact input bytes to canonical reserialization also rejects duplicate keys/noncanonical lexical encodings.
serialization.failureMapping: Standalone codec invalid input/context returns fixed invalid-input. Repository reconstruction of stored payload/key/context disagreement maps codec failure to fixed storage.
serialization.storedKeyCheck: Reconstructed envelope/payload identities and all version dimensions must agree with private map key as well as each other. No silent repair.

referenceAdapter: Private instance-local maps store canonical serialized strings only. No shared mutable source snapshot references, global state, timestamps, random IDs or external I/O implementation.
Reconstruct and revalidate every read, verifying canonical payload and exact references. Outputs/results/pages/snapshots are detached and deeply frozen. Do not freeze or mutate caller inputs.

Capture submitted domain content into detached local data before awaited dependency resolution so caller-held references cannot change the attempted payload during an append. Validate captured data through unchanged domain authorities.

After asynchronous dependency resolution and predecessor reconstruction, final exact-key retry comparison/current-predecessor check/insertion must run synchronously with no intervening await. Recheck map state at this final linearization point.
Same-instance competing valid identical appends produce one created and the rest already-present; differing same-key content produces one created and remaining conflict outcomes, without renumbering.
This proves only same-instance reference-adapter semantics, not independent-adapter/database concurrency or durability.

paginationAndLatest.validation: Limits must be positive safe integers <= 100. Omitted/undefined limit uses 20; reject null/strings/fractional/unsafe/out-of-range without coercion. Reject malformed options/unknown properties. Version/revision cursors require canonical positive safe integers; identity cursors use each family's canonical parser. Omitted/undefined cursor means beginning.
paginationAndLatest.histories: Ascending numeric version/revision with exclusive afterVersion/afterRevision. Bound returned items and return nextCursor only when more items exist, using last returned item.
paginationAndLatest.latestLists: One greatest stored sequential version per stable identity; ascending JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit identity order, exclusive afterId. No locale sorting or insertion-order dependence.
paginationAndLatest.latestMeaning: Latest/current denotes only repository stream sequencing, never publication approval, public visibility, availability freshness or readiness.
paginationAndLatest.deferred: No dish-filtered offer listing in this slice.

futureD1Considerations: Composite identity/version primary or unique keys; exact offer-to-presentation foreign references; publication membership/reference integrity; availability key (offerId, offerVersion, revision).
Append-only UPDATE/DELETE rejection and no cascaded deletion. Atomic predecessor/current checks; unique key alone is insufficient for sequential concurrency.
Publication membership may require normalized reference tables. No SQL, migrations, configuration or D1 adapters created here.
requiredTests: All 23 asynchronous methods; initial append, initial not 1, consecutive revision, gaps/missing/noncurrent predecessor, malformed versions and overflow.

Canonical identical retry, differing valid same-key conflict, historical identical retry after newer versions with correct predecessor/context, invalid retry predecessor rejection and exact retry precedence for every family.
Same-instance competing identical/conflicting appends; one created without renumbering; mutation of caller input during dependency await cannot alter stored attempt.
Exact historical/latest reads, ascending histories, deterministic latest listing, default/max/invalid limits and cursors, UTF-16 ordering including surrogate pairs and insertion-order independence.
Presentation exact FOOD-001 product/recipe correspondence, missing dependency invalid-input, thrown/corrupt/mismatched dependency storage and no FOOD-001 writes or private-context storage.
Offer dangling presentation rejection, exact historical reference and independent revisions, stable dish association and attempted dish move invalid-input; no latest substitution.

Publication dangling presentation/offer references and compatibility rejection; exact historical published/unpublished versions remain resolvable after newer records; stored publication grants no exposure.

Availability initial revision 1, consecutive/gap/overflow/dangling offer handling, independent exact-offer-version streams, current greatest sequential observation, new version starts not-found, old stream unchanged, retired history retained.

Every serializer/deserializer: key insertion order independent equality, meaningful array-order changes, format/discriminator/corrupt JSON/payload/metadata/key disagreement, exact context and canonical reserialization rejection.
Detached deeply frozen records/results/pages and frozen input compatibility; no shared mutable stored history or silent overwrite/delete/merge/repair APIs.

Fixed sanitized failures/conflict reason, failed reads/lists never become not-found/empty success; no payload/evidence/exception leakage; source isolation and no public activation/readiness semantics.
